Gradient Maker

Design CSS gradients visually — linear, radial or conic — with 3 color stops, angle control, live preview and copyable code.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick three colors using the color pickers.
  2. Choose linear, radial or conic type and set the angle.
  3. Copy the generated CSS gradient code for your project.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What gradient types are supported?

Linear (directional), radial (circular/elliptical from a center) and conic (sweeping around a center point).

What CSS is generated?

Standard CSS like linear-gradient(135deg, #ff0000 0%, #00ff00 50%, #0000ff 100%), ready to paste into any stylesheet.

Are the color stops evenly spaced?

Yes — the three stops sit at 0%, 50% and 100% for a balanced blend. For custom stop positions, adjust the code manually.
